parts.0.title: Hören — Listening
parts.0.instructions: Listen to each item and choose the right answer. In the real exam each item is played once or twice; here you can listen as often as you like, but try to listen at most twice.
parts.1.title: Lesen — Reading
parts.1.instructions: Read each text and choose the right answer. Richtig = correct, Falsch = wrong.
writing.0.taskBn: You are writing to Frau Wagner, your German course teacher: you cannot come to the course tomorrow because you are ill. Ask how you can catch up on the lesson. Write about 30–40 words (write on paper).
writing.1.taskBn: Your friend Julia has written that she is coming to your city. Write to her: say you are happy; where to meet; a place (e.g. a restaurant) you could go to; which day you have time. Write about 40–50 words.
speaking.0.instructions: Say 2–3 sentences about the topic on each card (about 30 seconds). Then compare with the model.
speaking.0.prompts.0.bn: Where and in what kind of home do you live?
speaking.0.prompts.1.bn: What is your job, or what are you studying?
speaking.0.prompts.2.bn: What do you do in your free time?
speaking.0.prompts.3.bn: Why and how are you learning German?
speaking.1.instructions: You and your friend are planning a small event. Make suggestions about time, place and who does what, ask questions and agree.
speaking.1.prompts.0.bn: Barbecue in the park — when, where, who brings what?
speaking.1.prompts.2.bn: Gift for a colleague — what, how much?
speaking.2.instructions: Make a polite request or suggestion; when you hear a request, respond (Ja, gern! / Tut mir leid, aber …).
speaking.2.prompts.0.bn: Ask to postpone a doctor's appointment
speaking.2.prompts.1.bn: Ask a friend to help you move
speaking.2.prompts.3.bn: Ask when you haven't understood something
